metadata.title: Kählerity of complete almost-Kähler gradient shrinking Ricci solitons
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we prove that any complete, compact or noncompact, almost-Kähler gradient shrinking Ricci soliton is Kähler in arbitrary even dimension. Among other applications, combining our result with the classification of complete Kähler-Ricci shrinker surfaces, we obtain a full classification of complete almost-Kähler gradient shrinking Ricci solitons in real dimension four.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明任意偶数维完备 almost-Kähler 梯度收缩 Ricci 孤立子必为 Kähler。
analysis.breakthrough: 去除紧致性限制，并结合已有分类完成四维完备 almost-Kähler shrinker 分类。
analysis.limitations: 四维分类推论仍依赖既有 Kähler--Ricci shrinker 曲面分类。
analysis.priorityReason: 按相关性、新颖性、技术复用性、潜在影响与证据清晰度综合评分为 89/100。
